verified_claims.claim: CLEAN 在 >50% 序列同一性切分下达到 0.865 F1，在 10% 切分下达到 0.67 F1
verified_claims.source_locator: 正文 Page 1 倒数第二段
verified_claims.evidence: CLEAN achieved a 0.865 F1 score… Even at 10% sequence identity clustering, CLEAN reached a 0.67 F1 score.

verified_claims.claim: New-392 数据集上 CLEAN precision 0.597、recall 0.481、F1 0.499；ProteInfer F1 0.309，DeepEC F1 0.230
verified_claims.source_locator: 正文 Page 2 左栏 Benchmarking 部分
verified_claims.evidence: precision (0.597) and recall (0.481)… CLEAN achieved an F1 score of 0.499, whereas ProteInfer and DeepEC had scores of 0.309 and 0.230, respectively.

verified_claims.claim: Price-149 数据集上 CLEAN F1 0.495，3.0 倍于 ProteInfer (0.166)、5.8 倍于 DeepEC (0.085)
verified_claims.evidence: CLEAN achieved the highest F1 score (0.495)… CLEAN had a 3.0-fold higher F1 score than ProteInfer (0.166) and an almost 5.8-fold higher score than DeepEC (0.085).

verified_claims.claim: underrepresented EC 验证集每种 EC ≤5 次出现、3000+ 样本、1000+ EC 号；CLEAN F1 0.817，ProteInfer/DeepEC 0.625–0.782
verified_claims.source_locator: 正文 Page 3 左栏 + 图 2C
verified_claims.evidence: each type of EC number had no more than five occurrences, and more than 3000 samples were included in this dataset covering more than 1000 different EC numbers… 0.625 to 0.782 F1 score… CLEAN outperformed both methods, achieving a 0.817 F1 score.

verified_claims.claim: 内部卤化酶数据集含 36 个酶，覆盖全部四种卤化酶；PDB IDs 为 MJ1651 2F4N、TTHA0338 2CW5、PH0463 1WU8、SsFlA 5B6I、SalL 2Q6O、ScFlA 1RQR
verified_claims.source_locator: 正文 Page 3 右栏 + 图 3 caption
verified_claims.evidence: 36 incompletely annotated halogenases have been identified from UniProt, covering all four types of halogenases… MJ1651 [PDB ID: 2F4N], TTHA0338 [PDB ID: 2CW5], and positive control enzyme PH0463 [PDB ID: 1WU8]… SsFlA [PDB ID: 5B6I], SalL [PDB ID: 2Q6O], and ScFlA [PDB ID: 1RQR].

verified_claims.claim: MJ1651 与阳性对照酶序列同一性 20.5–35.7%，仅 SsFlA vs ScFlA 为 87.6%；MJ1651 是 SAM 水解酶 (EC 3.13.1.8)，不是氯化酶 (EC 2.5.1.94) 或氟化酶 (EC 2.5.1.63)
verified_claims.evidence: sequence identity ranging from 20.5 to 35.7% for everything but SsFlA versus ScFlA, which is 87.6%… MJ1651 is SAM hydrolase (EC 3.13.1.8)… rather than chlorinase (EC 2.5.1.94) or fluorinase (EC 2.5.1.63), as mislabeled in UniProt.

verified_claims.claim: SsFlA 同时具有三个 EC 号 (EC 2.5.1.63、EC 2.5.1.94、EC 3.13.1.8)，HPLC-MS 验证三功能
verified_claims.evidence: CLEAN also confidently identified the promiscuous enzyme SsFlA with three EC numbers (EC 2.5.1.63, EC 2.5.1.94, and EC 3.13.1.8).
